remarks: Desirable and convenient road in North Stamford. This lovely expanded Cape Cod style home sits on a private acre. The main level boasts a spacious kitchen with Corian countertops, living room with fireplace, dining room, and family room. The primary suite has a fireplace and deck which overlooks the beautifully landscaped backyard. Expansive great room perfect for entertaining. Enjoy grilling, playing outdoor games or relaxing in the private yard. While enjoying this tranquil setting, you are close to Downtown Stamford, Metro North, shops & dining. *Possible 4th bedroom on main level.
